createAccount.title: Create your account
createAccount.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. You’ll use this to sign in on the restaurant’s devices.

switchAccount.title: Switch accounts?
switchAccount.body: This invitation is for {invited}, but this browser is signed in as {current}. Continuing signs this browser out of {current} and in as {invited}.

needsLink.expiredBody: Links in invitation emails work only once and stop working after a while. You can still join — sign in below.
needsLink.title: Join {workplace} as {role}
needsLink.signIn: I already have an account with this email — sign in
needsLink.noGoogle: No Google account? Create a free one with this same address, {email} — Google lets you use an email you already have, not just Gmail. Then come back here and continue with Google, or ask the restaurant for help.
needsLink.emailInvited: Invited by email and never set a password?
needsLink.sendLink: Email me a link to set my password
needsLink.sent: If {email} was invited by email, a link to set your password is on its way. Nothing after a few minutes? Continue with Google above.

wrongAccount.title: This invitation is for someone else
wrongAccount.body: This invitation is for {invited}, but you’re signed in as {current}. Sign out here, then sign in with {invited} — or ask the restaurant to invite the address you use.

failed.title: Couldn’t accept invite
failed.used: This invitation has already been used. If it was yours, sign in with Google or your password — or use “Forgot password?” if you never chose one.
failed.notFound: This invitation link is incomplete or no longer exists. Ask the restaurant to invite you again.

done.title: You’re in!
done.body: Welcome to {workplace}. Taking you to your screen…

errors.alreadyUsed: This invitation has already been used.
errors.notFound: This invitation no longer exists. Ask the restaurant to invite you again.
errors.confirmEmail: Your email address isn’t confirmed yet. Continue with Google, or confirm it from the email we sent you, then open this invitation link again.
errors.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again, then open this invitation link again.
errors.alreadyStaff: You already work at this restaurant with this account, at the same branch. Sign in to continue.
errors.emailMismatch: This invitation is for a different email address. Sign in with {email} to accept it.
errors.emailMismatchUnknown: This invitation is for a different email address. Sign in with the address the restaurant invited.
errors.joinFailed: Something went wrong joining the restaurant. Please try again.
errors.tooManyEmails: Too many emails were sent in the last hour. Please try again later.
errors.emailFailed: We could not send the email. Please try again, or ask the restaurant to invite you again.
errors.passwordsDontMatch: The two passwords do not match.
